title: Pro PDF Editor - Edit, Annotate, and Sign PDFs Online for Free
description: The most powerful, browser-based, private Pro PDF Editor. Edit text, add signatures, draw, and annotate your PDF files instantly without uploading them to any server.

features.title: 100% Privacy & Security
features.desc: Your files never leave your device. All PDF rendering, editing, and saving happen locally in your browser. No server uploads.

features.title: Advanced Signature Tool
features.desc: Easily draw your signature on the screen, type it using professional cursive fonts, or upload a pre-saved image to sign your documents.

features.title: Smart Text Editing & Whiteout
features.desc: Add new text with custom fonts and colors. Use our smart Whiteout (eraser) tool to hide unwanted existing text or watermarks seamlessly.

features.title: Contextual Page Management
features.desc: A professional UI allows you to select any page to rotate, delete, or manage it instantly using the contextual side panel.

faq.q: Is this PDF Editor truly free and private?
faq.a: Yes! niDar Tools Pro PDF Editor is completely free. We prioritize your privacy—your PDF files are processed directly on your computer/phone and are never uploaded to our servers.

faq.q: Can I edit existing text in a PDF?
faq.a: PDFs are essentially flat images of text. You can use our 'Annotate (Whiteout)' tool to erase existing text and then use the 'Text' tool to type new content over it.

faq.q: Does it work on mobile phones?
faq.a: Absolutely. The interface is optimized for both desktop and mobile devices, including touch-friendly drag-and-drop and signature features.
